title: The Claude 3 model family
before: GPT-4 had held the frontier alone for a year.
problem: No competitor had matched it across the board, and one model size fits no one.
breakthrough: Three sizes with a shared capability profile, vision input and 200K context, with Opus matching or beating GPT-4.
why: It ended GPT-4's uncontested lead and made tiered model families the standard product shape.
next: Claude 3.5 Sonnet showed a mid-tier could beat the previous flagship.
inherits: The small, medium, large family with one interface.
